questions.prompt: Do you have many books at home?
questions.sampleA1: Yes. I have books. Two books. They are good.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I have some books at home. I like books, and my sister likes books too. I read them sometimes, but not every day because I am busy.
questions.sampleB1: Yes, I have quite a few books at home. I enjoy reading, so I've collected them over time. I think it's important to have books because they can teach you new things. For example, I have some history books and some novels. However, I don't always have time to read as much as I'd like.
questions.sampleB2: Honestly, yes — I've got quite a stack. I'm a bit of a bookworm, so over the years I've built up a fair few, mostly novels and the odd cookbook. To be honest, I hang on to the ones I really love and lend out the rest to mates. There's just something cosy about a shelf that's crammed with them.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha. Menda kitoblar bor. Ikki dona kitob. Ular yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ha, uyimda bir nechta kitoblar bor. Men kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman, va singlim ham kitoblarni yaxshi ko'radi. Men ularni ba'zida o'qiyman, lekin har kuni emas, chunki men band bo'laman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Ha, uyda ancha kitobim bor. O'qishni yaxshi ko'raman, shuning uchun ularni vaqt o'tishi bilan to'plaganman. O'ylashimcha, kitoblar bo'lishi muhim, chunki ular sizga yangi narsalarni o'rgatishi mumkin. Masalan, menda ba'zi tarix kitoblari va ba'zi romanlar bor. Biroq, har doim ham xohlaganimcha o'qishga vaqtim bo'lmaydi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Uyda ancha ko'p kitobim bor, ha. Men o'zimni qat'iy ma'noda kolleksioner deb ayta olmayman, lekin yillar davomida ancha kutubxona to'pladim. O'qish uchun turli xil materiallarga ega bo'lish juda boyitadi deb o'ylayman. Asosan badiiy adabiyot o'qisam ham, ma'lumot olish va qo'shimcha o'rganish uchun badiiy bo'lmagan manbalar ham mavjudligini qadrlayman. Bu bolaligimdan beri rivojlantirgan odatim va uni davom ettirmoqchiman.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Do you have many books at home?...
idioms: "A room without books is like a body without a soul" - "Kitobsiz xona jonsiz tanaga o'xshaydi"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I have an extensive collection of books at home that I've accumulated over the years." - "Rostini aytsam, men yillar davomida yig'gan keng kitob kolleksiyasiga egaman."

"From my perspective, a home filled with literary treasures enriches the soul and stimulates the mind." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, adabiy xazinalar bilan to'ldirilgan uy ruhni boyitadi va ongni rivojlantiradi."
"I'd have to say that my shelves are brimming with volumes, as I'm quite the avid reader." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, men qizg'in o'quvchi sifatida mening javonlarim kitoblar bilan to'la."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Honestly, I have quite an extensive collection of books at home. I've always been an avid reader, and over the years, my collection has grown considerably. I believe that books are not just a source of knowledge but also a window into different worlds and perspectives. As the saying goes, "A room without books is like a body without a soul."

My collection is quite eclectic, ranging from classic literature to contemporary fiction, and spanning multiple genres including science fiction, history, and biographies. I often pick up books from second-hand shops and high-street stores, and I have a particular fondness for collecting rare and antique editions. Moreover, I make it a point to visit libraries and book fairs whenever I can to add to my collection.

Reading is not just a hobby for me; it's a way of life. It allows me to let my hair down and escape the hustle and bustle of daily life. Through reading, I can travel to distant lands, explore new ideas, and gain deeper insights into the human experience. I truly cherish my books, and I believe that each one adds immense value to my life.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, uyimda kitoblarning ancha katta to'plami bor. Men doim kitob o'qishga qiziqqanman va yillar davomida mening to'plamim sezilarli darajada o'sdi. Menimcha, kitoblar nafaqat bilim manbai, balki turli olamlar va nuqtai nazarlarga ochilgan deraza hamdir. Aytishlaricha, "Kitobsiz xona jonsiz tanaga o'xshaydi".

Mening to'plamim juda xilma-xildir, klassik adabiyotdan tortib zamonaviy fantastikagacha, ilmiy fantastika, tarix va biografiya kabi ko'plab janrlarni o'z ichiga oladi. Men ko'pincha ikkinchi qo'l do'konlaridan va katta ko'cha do'konlaridan kitoblar sotib olaman va nodir va antik nashrlarni to'plashni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Bundan tashqari, men imkon qadar kutubxonalarga va kitob yarmarkalariga tashrif buyurib, to'plamimni boyitishga harakat qilaman.

Kitob o'qish men uchun shunchaki xobbi emas; bu hayot tarzi. Bu menga dam olish va kundalik hayotning shovqinidan qochish imkonini beradi. Kitob o'qish orqali men uzoq o'lkalarga sayohat qilishim, yangi g'oyalarni o'rganishim va insoniyat tajribasi haqida chuqurroq tushunchaga ega bo'lishim mumkin. Men kitoblarimni chin dildan qadrlayman va ularning har biri hayotimga beqiyos qadriyat qo'shadi deb hisoblayman.

Shuningdek, menga uning fransuz tilida kuylashi yoqadi, garchi men barcha so'zlarni tushunmasam ham. Biroq, menimcha, uning ohanglari juda tez yodda qoladi.

Men ayniqsa hayratlanadigan qo'shiqchilardan biri - Ispaniyalik Rosaliya. Uning musiqasi an'anaviy flamenkoni zamonaviy ohanglar bilan uyg'unlashtiradi, bu juda innovatsion. Shuningdek, uning o'z madaniy merosini chiqishlariga qanday kiritishini ham qadrlayman. Musiqa til to'siqlaridan qanday o'tib, butun dunyo odamlarini bog'lashi juda qiziq. Garchi men barcha qo'shiqlarning so'zlarini tushunmasam ham, uning musiqasidagi san'at va hissiyotni qadrlay olaman.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Honestly, I have an immense appreciation for foreign singers, as they bring a breath of fresh air into my music library. One artist that particularly stands out for me is the sensational Adele. Her voice is incredibly powerful, and she has this uncanny ability to tap into the deepest emotions, which is quite rare. Many of her songs, such as "Someone Like You" and "Hello," are true masterpieces that resonate with people across the globe.

Moreover, Adele’s music offers a perfect blend of soulful lyrics and haunting melodies. Her ability to connect with her audience on such a personal level is, in my opinion, a testament to her artistry. I also enjoy how she wears her heart on her sleeve, something that makes her music genuinely relatable. In a world where high-street stores often dictate trends, Adele marches to the beat of her own drum, maintaining her authenticity.

"Music is the universal language of mankind," and Adele exemplifies this by transcending cultural and linguistic barriers. Overall, her ability to bring out emotions and her unwavering dedication to her craft make her an artist I truly admire.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, men xorijiy xonandalarni juda qadrlayman, chunki ular mening musiqa kutubxonamga yangi nafas olib kirishadi. Ayniqsa, men uchun ajralib turadigan san'atkorlardan biri bu sensatsion Adele. Uning ovozi nihoyatda kuchli va uning eng chuqur his-tuyg'ularga kirib bora olish qobiliyati bor, bu juda kam uchraydi. Uning "Someone Like You" va "Hello" kabi ko'plab qo'shiqlari butun dunyo bo'ylab odamlarning qalbidan joy olgan haqiqiy durdonalardir.

Bundan tashqari, Adelening musiqasi dilga yaqin so'zlar va sehrli ohanglarning mukammal uyg'unligini taqdim etadi. Uning o'z tomoshabinlari bilan shaxsiy darajada bog'lana olish qobiliyati, mening fikrimcha, uning san'atkorligining dalilidir. Men uning qalbi ochiqligini ham yoqtiraman, bu uning musiqasini chinakam yaqin qiladi. Ko'pincha do'konlar trendlarni belgilaydigan dunyoda, Adele o'z yo'lidan boradi va o'zining haqiqiyligini saqlab qoladi.

"Musiqa - insoniyatning umumiy tilidir", va Adele madaniy va til to'siqlaridan o'tib, buni isbotlaydi. Umuman olganda, uning his-tuyg'ularni uyg'ota olish qobiliyati va o'z hunariga bo'lgan qat'iy sadoqati uni men chin dildan qadrlaydigan san'atkorga aylantiradi.

questions.sampleAnswer:
When it comes to fashion, I absolutely adore my leather jacket. This particular garment not only epitomizes my personal style but also carries a sentimental value that makes it "worth its weight in gold". I distinctly remember the day I stumbled upon it while browsing through a vintage shop, and since then, it has become a staple in my wardrobe.

What I really love about this jacket is its versatility. I can pair it with almost anything, from a simple T-shirt and jeans to a more formal ensemble. It brings out an edgy yet sophisticated look, enabling me to transition effortlessly from a casual day out with friends to a business meeting.

Beyond its aesthetic appeal, the leather jacket also genuinely provides comfort and warmth during the chilly months. The material is incredibly durable, which means it will last me for years to come, "standing the test of time". Furthermore, wearing it often feels like "putting on an old friend"—it just fits perfectly and gives me a sense of confidence.

In conclusion, my leather jacket is undoubtedly my favourite item of clothing because it strikes a balance between practicality and style, all while holding cherished memories. It reflects my personality and has become an essential part of my identity, much like a signature piece in an art collection.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Modaga kelganda, men o‘zimning charm kurtkamni juda yaxshi ko‘raman. Bu kiyim nafaqat mening shaxsiy uslubimni ifodalaydi, balki uni "oltin narxiga arziydigan" qilib qo‘yadigan qadriyatlarga ham ega. Men uni eski buyumlar do‘konida ko‘rib qolgan kunimni aniq eslayman va o‘shandan beri u mening garderobimning asosiy qismiga aylandi.

Bu kurtkaning menga juda yoqadigan jihati uning ko‘p qirraliligidir. Men uni deyarli har qanday narsa bilan, oddiy futbolka va jinsidan tortib, yanada rasmiy ansamblgacha moslashtira olaman. U o‘tkir, ammo nafis ko‘rinishni yaratadi, bu esa menga do‘stlar bilan oddiy sayrdan tortib, biznes uchrashuvigacha bemalol o‘tish imkonini beradi.

Estetik jozibasidan tashqari, charm kurtka sovuq oylarda chinakam qulaylik va iliqlikni ta'minlaydi. Material juda bardoshli, ya'ni u menga ko'p yillar davomida xizmat qiladi, "vaqt sinovidan o'tadi". Bundan tashqari, uni kiyish ko'pincha "eski do'stni kiygandek" tuyuladi - u shunchaki mukammal mos keladi va menga o'ziga ishonch hissini beradi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, mening charm kurtkam, shubhasiz, mening eng sevimli kiyimim, chunki u amaliylik va uslub o'rtasida muvozanatni saqlaydi, shu bilan birga qadrdon xotiralarni saqlaydi. U mening shaxsiyatimni aks ettiradi va san'at kolleksiyasidagi imzo buyumiga o'xshab, mening kimligimning muhim qismiga aylandi.

questions.sampleAnswer: In the first image, I immediately notice the train carriage, which is beautifully designed to enhance the travel experience. The panoramic windows offer up a breathtaking view of the landscape outside, where the rolling hills and a flowing river paint a picture of serenity. Naturally, the passengers, while masked and aware of health protocols, seem to be enjoying this social experience of travel, as they gaze intently outside. The atmosphere inside the train is undeniably peaceful, enhanced by the bright and airy setting created by the generous influx of natural light. Conversely, the second image captures a moment of sheer joy and anticipation as a man steps down from an airplane. His attire, a striped long-sleeve shirt paired with beige shorts, coupled with a stylish hat, speaks to the laid-back vibe of someone ready for a well-deserved vacation. The airplane in the background, gleaming under the bright daylight, adds to the optimistic mood. It's a breath of fresh air to witness such unadulterated happiness, particularly in these times when travel is cherished more than ever. As the saying goes, "Travel is the only thing you buy that makes you richer."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi suratda men darhol poyezd vagonini payqadim, u sayohat tajribasini yaxshilash uchun juda chiroyli tarzda loyihalashtirilgan. Panoramali derazalar tashqaridagi manzaraga hayratlanarli ko'rinish beradi, u yerda to'lqinli tepaliklar va oqayotgan daryo xotirjamlik manzarasini yaratadi. Tabiiyki, yo'lovchilar, niqobda bo'lishiga va sog'liqni saqlash protokollaridan xabardor bo'lishiga qaramay, tashqariga diqqat bilan tikilib, sayohatning bu ijtimoiy tajribasidan zavqlanayotganga o'xshaydi. Poyezd ichidagi atmosfera shubhasiz tinch, tabiiy yorug'likning mo'l-ko'l kirib kelishi natijasida yaratilgan yorqin va havodor muhit bilan yanada yaxshilanadi.

Aksincha, ikkinchi suratda samolyotdan tushayotgan odamning chinakam quvonch va umidvorlik lahzasi aks etgan. Uning kiyimi, yo'l-yo'l uzun yengli ko'ylak va bej rangli shortilar, zamonaviy shlyapa bilan birgalikda, munosib ta'tilga tayyor bo'lgan odamning beparvo kayfiyatidan dalolat beradi. Orqa fonda yorqin kunduzgi yorug'lik ostida porlab turgan samolyot optimistik kayfiyatga hissa qo'shadi. Bunday sof baxtni ko'rish - bu bir hovuch toza havo, ayniqsa, sayohat har qachongidan ham qadrlanadigan hozirgi zamonda. Aytishlaricha, "Sayohat - bu sizni boy qiladigan yagona narsa".

questions.sampleAnswer:
Personally, I genuinely believe that planes and trains both have their own unique advantages, but when it comes to ultimate convenience, planes often come out on top. "Time is money," and flights are typically faster, making them the go-to choice for long distances.

Take, for example, my last trip from London to Paris. Flying was incredibly efficient because it saved me a good amount of time that I would've otherwise spent traveling by train. Although trains can be remarkably comfortable and offer scenic views, the speed and efficiency of air travel really sealed the deal for me.

Moreover, airports, despite their hustle and bustle, have become highly organized with sophisticated systems in place to ensure travelers get through security and board their flights with ease. On the other hand, trains are great for letting your hair down and enjoying a more relaxed journey, especially on routes where the landscape is breathtakingly beautiful.

That said, if one values environmental sustainability, trains are undoubtedly the better option. They are more eco-friendly and generate a much smaller carbon footprint compared to planes. Ultimately, the choice between a plane and a train depends on what the traveler values more: speed and efficiency, or comfort and sustainability.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shaxsan men, samolyotlar va poyezdlarning har birining o'ziga xos afzalliklari bor deb chin dildan ishonaman, lekin eng qulaylik haqida gap ketganda, samolyotlar ko'pincha ustun keladi. "Vaqt - pul", va odatda samolyotlar tezroq bo'lgani uchun, ular uzoq masofalar uchun eng yaxshi tanlovdir.

Masalan, Londondan Parijga bo'lgan oxirgi sayohatimni olaylik. Samolyotda uchish juda samarali bo'ldi, chunki u menga poyezdda sayohat qilishga sarflashim mumkin bo'lgan ko'p vaqtni tejadi. Poyezdlar juda qulay va manzarali ko'rinishlarni taqdim etishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, havo transportining tezligi va samaradorligi men uchun masalani hal qildi.

Bundan tashqari, aeroportlar, shovqin-suroniga qaramay, sayohatchilar xavfsizlikdan oson o'tishlari va samolyotga chiqishlarini ta'minlash uchun murakkab tizimlar bilan juda yaxshi tashkil etilgan. Boshqa tomondan, poyezdlar, ayniqsa, landshaft hayratlanarli darajada go'zal bo'lgan yo'nalishlarda, dam olish va yanada xotirjam sayohatdan bahramand bo'lish uchun juda yaxshi.

Shunga qaramay, agar kimdir atrof-muhit barqarorligini qadrlasa, poyezdlar, shubhasiz, yaxshiroq variantdir. Ular ekologik jihatdan toza va samolyotlarga nisbatan ancha kam uglerod izini hosil qiladi. Oxir oqibat, samolyot va poyezd o'rtasidagi tanlov sayohatchi nimani ko'proq qadrlashiga bog'liq: tezlik va samaradorlik yoki qulaylik va barqarorlik.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Do you prefer traveling by plane or by train?...
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find air travel to be exhilarating, yet trains offer a unique charm." - "Rostini aytsam, men uchun havo sayohati hayajonli, lekin poyezdlar o'ziga xos jozibaga ega."

"From my perspective, the choice between plane and train travel depends on the nature of the journey." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, samolyot va poyezd sayohati o'rtasidagi tanlov sayohatning xarakteriga bog'liq."
"I'd have to say that both modes of transportation have their distinctive advantages." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, har ikkala transport vositasi o'ziga xos afzalliklarga ega."

questions.sampleAnswer:
When it comes to choosing between traveling by plane or train, I honestly find it a tough nut to crack. Each mode of transport has its own unique charm. However, if I had to choose, I would probably lean more towards traveling by train. One of the main reasons is the scenic beauty that you can enjoy during a train journey. Unlike flying, where you are cooped up in a metal tube, train travel allows you to let your hair down and take in the breathtaking landscapes as they pass by.

Additionally, train travel offers a more social experience. It's not uncommon to strike up conversations with fellow passengers, which can be quite enriching and add to the overall journey. Moreover, the absence of the tedious airport formalities makes it a breath of fresh air. You can simply hop on and hop off without the hassle of lengthy security checks and long waits.

On the other hand, flying is undoubtedly faster and often a necessity for international travel. However, when time permits, I genuinely relish the leisurely pace of train journeys, as they allow me to unwind and reflect. As the saying goes, "It's not the destination, but the journey that matters". For me, the train offers an enjoyable and memorable journey, making it my preferred mode of travel.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Samolyotda yoki poyezdda sayohat qilishni tanlashga kelganda, rostini aytsam, bu men uchun qiyin masala. Transportning har bir turining o'ziga xos jozibasi bor. Biroq, agar tanlashim kerak bo'lsa, men ehtimol poyezdda sayohat qilishga ko'proq moyil bo'lardim. Asosiy sabablardan biri shundaki, poyezd safarida siz bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin bo'lgan go'zal manzaralar mavjud. Uchishdan farqli o'laroq, u yerda siz metall quvurda qamalib qolasiz, poyezdda sayohat qilish sizga erkin nafas olishga va o'tib ketayotgan hayratlanarli manzaralarni tomosha qilishga imkon beradi.

Bundan tashqari, poyezdda sayohat qilish ko'proq ijtimoiy tajribani taqdim etadi. Yo'lovchilar bilan suhbatlashish odatiy hol, bu juda foydali bo'lishi va umumiy safarga qo'shimcha qulaylik yaratishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, zerikarli aeroport rasmiyatchiliklarining yo'qligi uni bir hovuch toza havo qiladi. Siz shunchaki uzoq xavfsizlik tekshiruvlari va uzoq kutishlarsiz bemalol chiqib ketishingiz va tushishingiz mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, samolyotda uchish, shubhasiz, tezroq va ko'pincha xalqaro sayohat uchun zarurdir. Biroq, vaqt imkon berganda, men poyezd safarlarining xotirjam sur'atidan chin dildan zavqlanaman, chunki ular menga dam olish va fikrlash imkonini beradi. Aytishlaricha, "Muhimi manzil emas, balki safarning o'zi". Men uchun poyezd yoqimli va unutilmas sayohatni taqdim etadi, bu esa uni mening afzal ko'rgan transport turiga aylantiradi.

questions.prompt: Describe an achievement that you consider a personal success.
questions.sampleA1: I run. I run fast. I win race. I happy.
questions.sampleA2: I play football and I am good. My team won the game and I scored a goal. I was very happy because we worked hard and we won.
questions.sampleB1: An achievement I'm proud of is when I learned to play the guitar. It was difficult at first, but I practiced every day. I think it was a success because now I can play my favorite songs. Also, I enjoy playing for my friends and family.
questions.sampleB2: An achievement I'm genuinely proud of was organising a charity fundraiser for my local community centre. Honestly, at the start I hadn't got a clue what I was doing — I had to rally a team of volunteers, chase down sponsors and pull the whole event together from scratch. There were plenty of moments when I nearly threw in the towel, but I stuck with it, and on the day we raised far more than we'd ever hoped for. Seeing the whole neighbourhood come together for a good cause was incredibly rewarding, and I suppose that's when it really sank in that I'd pulled it off. Looking back, the thing is, that experience completely changed the way I set goals. It taught me to break big, daunting targets down into small, manageable steps rather than getting overwhelmed. It also gave me the confidence to take on things that once felt well out of my depth, so now I tend to dive in headfirst rather than talk myself out of a challenge. As for what success actually means, I think it varies wildly from person to person. In some cultures it's measured by wealth or status, whereas in others it's far more about family, contentment or giving back to your community. For me personally, success isn't about ticking the boxes society hands you — it's about growing as a person and making a genuine difference, however small. At the end of the day, if I can look back and feel I've left things a little better than I found them, that's what I'd call a real success.

bulletPoints: Describe an achievement that you consider a personal success.
How did this success influence your approach to future goals?
How does the definition of success vary between cultures or individuals?
questions.sampleAnswer:
One achievement that I truly consider a personal success was when I completed my first marathon. It was an arduous journey, requiring months of intensive training and unwavering commitment. Crossing that finish line was not only a testament to my physical endurance but also a profound realization of my ability to push through mental barriers.

This achievement has significantly influenced my approach to future goals. I now take on challenges with a mindset that "a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step." This proverb has become a guiding principle for me, emphasizing the importance of consistency and dedication in achieving long-term objectives. Moreover, I have become more resilient, embracing the idea that setbacks are merely setups for a great comeback.

As for the definition of success, it varies greatly between cultures and individuals. In some cultures, success is often linked to material wealth and professional achievements, while others may prioritize familial bonds and personal happiness. For instance, in many Western societies, climbing the corporate ladder is seen as a hallmark of success, whereas in certain Eastern cultures, harmony and community well-being might take precedence. On a personal level, individuals may gauge success by their ability to let their hair down and find balance in life's various demands.

In conclusion, my marathon experience has taught me to approach my aspirations with a resilient spirit and an appreciation for the journey itself rather than just the destination. Understanding the diverse definitions of success has also enriched my perspective, reminding me that while success might have different facets, it is ultimately a deeply personal journey.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men chinakam shaxsiy muvaffaqiyat deb hisoblagan yutuqlarimdan biri bu mening birinchi marafonimni yakunlaganim bo'ldi. Bu mashaqqatli yo'l bo'lib, oylab intensiv mashg'ulotlar va qat'iy sadoqatni talab qildi. Marra chizig'ini kesib o'tish nafaqat mening jismoniy chidamliligimning dalili, balki aqliy to'siqlarni yengib o'tish qobiliyatimni chuqur anglash edi.

Bu yutuq kelajakdagi maqsadlarimga bo'lgan yondashuvimga sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatdi. Men endi "ming milyalik yo'l birinchi qadamdan boshlanadi" degan fikr bilan qiyinchiliklarni qabul qilaman. Bu maqol menga uzoq muddatli maqsadlarga erishishda izchillik va fidoyilikning muhimligini ta'kidlab, yo'naltiruvchi tamoyilga aylandi. Bundan tashqari, men yanada chidamli bo'lib, muvaffaqiyatsizliklar shunchaki buyuk qaytish uchun tayyorgarlik ekanligini angladim.

Muvaffaqiyatning ta'rifi madaniyatlar va shaxslar o'rtasida juda katta farq qiladi. Ba'zi madaniyatlarda muvaffaqiyat ko'pincha moddiy boylik va professional yutuqlar bilan bog'liq bo'lsa, boshqalari oilaviy rishtalar va shaxsiy baxtni ustun qo'yishi mumkin. Misol uchun, ko'plab G'arb jamiyatlarida korporativ zinapoyadan ko'tarilish muvaffaqiyatning belgisi sifatida qaralsa, ba'zi Sharq madaniyatlarida uyg'unlik va jamiyat farovonligi birinchi o'ringa chiqishi mumkin. Shaxsiy darajada, odamlar muvaffaqiyatni hayotning turli talablarida dam olish va muvozanatni topish qobiliyati bilan o'lchashi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, marafon tajribam menga intilishlarimga chidamli ruh va faqat manzilga emas, balki yo'lning o'ziga ham minnatdorchilik bilan yondashishni o'rgatdi. Muvaffaqiyatning turli ta'riflarini tushunish ham mening nuqtai nazarimni boyitdi va muvaffaqiyat turli qirralarga ega bo'lishi mumkinligini eslatib, bu oxir-oqibatda chuqur shaxsiy sayohatdir.

questions.prompt: Wealthy individuals should be taxed at higher rates.
questions.sampleA1: Money good. Rich people have money. Tax... maybe good.
questions.sampleA2: Rich people have money. I think tax is okay, because the government needs money. And the money can help people. But maybe rich people don't like it.
questions.sampleB1: I think wealthy people should pay more tax. It's because they have a lot of money. The government can use that money for schools and hospitals, for example. However, some people say it's not fair to tax rich people more. But I think it's important to help everyone.
questions.sampleB2: This is a real hot-button issue, and I can genuinely see both sides of the coin. On the one hand, the people who back higher taxes on the wealthy argue that those who've done well can easily afford to chip in a bit more. That extra revenue could be ploughed into schools, hospitals and welfare, which would help narrow the gap between rich and poor. From that angle, it comes across as a fair way of sharing the burden across society. On the other hand, critics reckon that taxing high earners too heavily can backfire. The worry is that it might discourage people from working hard or setting up businesses, and in some cases the very wealthy simply move their money abroad to dodge the taxman altogether. If that happens, the country could actually end up worse off, so it's a bit of a double-edged sword. Personally, though, I lean towards the idea that the well-off should pay a fair share. The thing is, someone on a modest wage feels every penny of tax, whereas a slight rise barely dents a millionaire's lifestyle. That said, I don't think you can just hammer them with sky-high rates — it has to be sensible and gradual, otherwise you drive people away. So all in all, I'm in favour of higher taxes on the wealthy, provided the money is spent wisely and the system stays fair. At the end of the day, a society works best when everyone pulls their weight according to what they can genuinely afford.

for: Higher taxes on the wealthy can reduce income inequality.
Additional revenue can fund essential public services.
The wealthiest individuals benefit disproportionately from societal systems.
against: High taxes may discourage investment and entrepreneurship.
Wealthy individuals often find ways to legally avoid taxes.
Redistribution alone doesn't address the root causes of poverty.

questions.sampleAnswer:
When it comes to the notion of taxing wealthy individuals at higher rates, there are compelling arguments on both sides of the debate. "With great power comes great responsibility," and in the context of wealth, this "quote" suggests that those with substantial financial resources should contribute more to society. Certainly, imposing higher taxes on the affluent can reduce income inequality, thereby fostering a more equitable society. The additional revenue generated could be channeled into essential public services like healthcare and education, which benefit everyone, but especially those from disadvantaged backgrounds.

Moreover, it’s undeniable that the wealthiest individuals often benefit disproportionately from societal systems such as infrastructure and legal protections. Given these advantages, there is a strong case to be made for them stepping up and contributing their fair share.

However, it's important to consider the arguments against such tax policies. Higher taxes might discourage investment and entrepreneurship, which are critical drivers of economic growth and job creation. Furthermore, wealthy individuals often have the means to figure out legal ways to minimize their tax liabilities, which can put a dent in the effectiveness of such policies.

Additionally, focusing solely on redistribution doesn't get to the root of poverty. Addressing poverty requires a multifaceted approach, including education, healthcare access, and economic opportunities. In essence, while higher taxes on the wealthy might offer some benefits, they should be part of a broader strategy aimed at creating a more just and prosperous society.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Boy odamlar yuqori stavkalarda soliqqa tortilishi haqidagi tushunchaga kelganda, bahsning har ikki tomonida ham ta'sirchan dalillar mavjud. "Katta kuch bilan katta mas'uliyat keladi" va boylik kontekstida bu "iqtibos" shuni ko'rsatadiki, katta moliyaviy resurslarga ega bo'lganlar jamiyatga ko'proq hissa qo'shishlari kerak. Albatta, badavlatlarga yuqori soliqlar solish daromad tengsizligini kamaytirishi va shu bilan yanada adolatli jamiyatni shakllantirishi mumkin. Olingan qo'shimcha daromad sog'liqni saqlash va ta'lim kabi muhim davlat xizmatlariga yo'naltirilishi mumkin, bu esa hammaga, ayniqsa, nochor ahvoldagi odamlarga foyda keltiradi.

Bundan tashqari, eng boy odamlar infratuzilma va huquqiy himoya kabi ijtimoiy tizimlardan nomutanosib ravishda foyda olishlari inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Ushbu afzalliklarni hisobga olgan holda, ularning o'z hissalarini qo'shishlari uchun kuchli asos bor.

Biroq, bunday soliq siyosatiga qarshi dalillarni ko'rib chiqish muhim. Yuqori soliqlar investitsiyalar va tadbirkorlikni susaytirishi mumkin, ular iqtisodiy o'sish va ish o'rinlarini yaratishning muhim omillari hisoblanadi. Bundan tashqari, boy odamlar ko'pincha soliq majburiyatlarini minimallashtirishning qonuniy usullarini topishga qodir, bu esa bunday siyosatning samaradorligiga putur yetkazishi mumkin.

Qolaversa, faqat qayta taqsimlashga e'tibor qaratish kambag'allikning ildiziga yetib bormaydi. Kambag'allikka qarshi kurashish ta'lim, sog'liqni saqlash imkoniyati va iqtisodiy imkoniyatlarni o'z ichiga olgan ko'p qirrali yondashuvni talab qiladi. Aslida, boylarga yuqori soliqlar solish ba'zi afzalliklarni taqdim etishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, ular yanada adolatli va farovon jamiyat yaratishga qaratilgan kengroq strategiyaning bir qismi bo'lishi kerak.
